notes: Independently read all nine eligible production TypeScript files, both metadata files, root/extensions/SDK/plugins AGENTS.md, and the complete benchmark contract and README. Expectations were manually derived without Inspector implementation, helpers, output or other fixtures.

All 16 files under extensions/migrate-claude are partitioned into 11 reviewed and five excluded records. Package metadata exposes only ./index.ts; there are no build-output exceptions or declaration files. Production and metadata bytes were compared with the pinned source commit.

All production relative imports remain within this plugin root; there is no additional plugin-owned or shared shipped source boundary. Node built-ins and separately installed @openclaw/fs-safe/walk are outside this SDK benchmark; their implementations were not audited.

helpers.ts explicitly reexports SDK pathExists as exists. Local imports in source.ts and skills.ts preserve its original SDK identity and import/reexport/call provenance. Closed literal probe tuples also establish member-access for their known exists rows; isDirectory remains a separate plugin-owned function.

The API runtime handle is passed from index.ts through buildClaudeMigrationProvider and applyClaudePlan into the known SDK helper withCachedMigrationConfigRuntime. MigrationProviderContext.runtime is PluginRuntime, but this plugin selects no concrete runtime member; no runtime root or api.runtime prefix is emitted, and known SDK helper internals are not inferred.

Migration contexts, planned targets and SDK helper return values are not plugin API objects. Their config, source, workspaceDir and other data properties do not create API/runtime member findings. MigrationProviderContext["runtime"] selects the whole runtime handle and creates only its SDK type dependency.

There are no named API hook registrations. Claude configuration keys called hooks are imported user data, not API hook declarations. The only manifest contract is contracts.migrationProviders = claude; descriptive and configuration metadata are not contracts.

Source-syntax classification retains explicit type imports and type references. plugin-entry and migration-runtime module identities are mixed due to independent value and type import sites. SDK constants passed as bare values gain no additional member-access kind. No genuine unresolved dependency construct remains.
